name: mcp-telegram

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Return the Telegram accounts currently signed in on this machine.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Open a browser window where the user signs in to Telegram (phone → code → 2FA). Resolves once the user finishes. Use this when no account is signed in or to add another one.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Drop the local session for an account and revoke it on the Telegram side.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Return the profile of the authenticated user for the chosen account.

tools.name: open_settings
tools.description: Open a local browser tab where the user can toggle read-only mode and edit the tool allowlist / blocklist. Resolves when the user closes the tab. Changes are persisted to ~/.telegram-agent/state.json; the MCP client must be restarted to pick them up. Env vars (MCP_TELEGRAM_READONLY / TOOLS / DISABLE) override stored values and are shown as locked in the UI.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Change own first name, last name, or about. Omitted fields are left untouched.

tools.name: update_my_username
tools.description: Set or clear (empty string) own public username.

tools.name: set_birthday
tools.description: Set the account birthday. Year is optional.

tools.name: set_profile_photo
tools.description: Upload a new profile photo from a local path or URL.

tools.name: list_dialogs
tools.description: List available Telegram dialogs, chats and channels for the chosen account.

unread.description: Only return dialogs with unread messages

tools.name: search_dialogs
tools.description: Find dialogs by a substring against their name/title/username.

tools.name: resolve_username
tools.description: Look up a user, channel, or chat by @username.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: Return the user-defined folders (a.k.a. chat filters) with their inclusion rules.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List messages in a dialog. Newest first.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search messages within one dialog. Supports text substring, type filter (photos/links/etc), sender filter, and date range. Newest first unless reverse=true.

query.description: Substring to match in the message text

fromUser.description: Username (@nick) or numeric id of the sender to filter by

minDate.description: Unix seconds — exclude messages older than this

maxDate.description: Unix seconds — exclude messages newer than this

tools.name: search_global
tools.description: Search messages across every chat the user is in. Useful for "find that link about X".

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Fetch one or several messages from a dialog by their ids.

tools.name: mark_as_read
tools.description: Mark a dialog (and optionally up to a specific message id) as read.

maxId.description: Mark messages up to this id (inclusive). Omit to mark all.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a dialog. Supports reply, forum topic, silent, scheduled delivery, and parse mode.

schedule.description: Unix seconds — send at this time instead of now

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit the text of a previously sent message.

tools.name: delete_messages
tools.description: Delete messages by id. `revoke` (default true) deletes for all participants where possible.

tools.name: forward_messages
tools.description: Forward messages from one dialog to another.

tools.name: pin_message
tools.description: Pin a message in the dialog.

pmOneSide.description: In PMs, pin only on your side (default false)

tools.name: unpin_message
tools.description: Unpin a specific message, or pass no id to unpin everything in the dialog.

tools.name: send_message_to_phone
tools.description: Send a Telegram message to someone identified only by their phone number. The phone is briefly added to contacts (Telegram requires this), the message is sent, then the contact entry is removed by default. Phone must include country code (e.g. +12025550123).

firstName.description: Name used for the temporary contact entry

keepContact.description: Do not remove the contact afterwards (default false)

tools.name: get_saved_reaction_tags
tools.description: Return all reaction-tags the user has set on Saved Messages, with their custom titles and per-tag message counts. Premium feature; works only on the `me` peer.

peer.description: Scope tags to a saved-dialog (forwarded-from peer). Omit for global Saved tags.

tools.name: update_saved_reaction_tag
tools.description: Set or clear the custom title of a Saved-Messages reaction-tag. Pass `title` to rename, omit to clear. Premium feature.

emoji.description: Emoji tag, e.g. "🧠". Either this or customEmojiId required.

tools.name: get_default_tag_reactions
tools.description: Server-suggested default emoji set for Saved-Messages tagging.

tools.name: search_saved_messages
tools.description: Search inside Saved Messages (`me`). Combine free-text `query` with `tagEmoji` and/or `tagCustomEmojiIds` to filter by reaction-tag. Newest first.

savedPeer.description: Filter to a Saved-Messages sub-dialog (the original sender peer)

tools.name: get_saved_dialogs
tools.description: List the forum-style sub-dialogs inside Saved Messages — each grouping forwards from one origin peer.

tools.name: get_saved_history
tools.description: Fetch messages inside one Saved-Messages sub-dialog (filtered by original sender peer).

peer.description: Original sender peer (the saved sub-dialog id / @username)

tools.name: delete_saved_history
tools.description: Wipe all messages in one Saved-Messages sub-dialog (forwards from a single origin peer). Irreversible.

peer.description: Original sender peer to clear from Saved Messages

maxId.description: Only delete messages up to this id (inclusive).

tools.name: toggle_saved_dialog_pin
tools.description: Pin/unpin one of the forum-style sub-dialogs inside Saved Messages.

peer.description: Original sender peer of the saved sub-dialog

pinned.description: true to pin, false/omit to unpin

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Upload and send one or more files. Each path may be an absolute local path or an `https://` URL. Passing multiple paths sends them as an album.

path.description: Local path, URL, or array of those for an album

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Download the media attached to a message. Files land in /tmp/.telegram-agent/downloads (override with MCP_TELEGRAM_DOWNLOADS env). Returns the absolute path.

tools.name: download_profile_photo
tools.description: Download the profile photo of a user/chat/channel. Saved under /tmp/.telegram-agent/downloads.

tools.name: transcribe_message
tools.description: Request a transcription of a voice note or video message. Requires a Telegram Premium account. The response may be pending — re-call to poll, passing the same message id.

tools.name: send_reaction
tools.description: Set one or more reactions on a message. Pass an empty reaction list to remove existing reactions.

tools.name: get_message_reactions
tools.description: Fetch the current reactions for one or more messages in a dialog.

tools.name: set_default_reaction
tools.description: Set the quick reaction emoji shown on long-press in clients.

tools.name: send_poll
tools.description: Send a poll. For a quiz, set `quiz: true` and `correctAnswerIndex` (0-based). Use `closePeriod` (seconds) or `closeDate` (unix seconds) to auto-close.

solution.description: Explanation shown after a quiz answer

tools.name: vote_poll
tools.description: Cast a vote on a poll by the index(es) of the chosen options.

tools.name: close_poll
tools.description: Finalize a poll so no further votes are accepted.

tools.name: get_poll_results
tools.description: Fetch the current vote tally for a poll message.

tools.name: list_stories
tools.description: Return the stories feed (other users' active stories).

tools.name: get_peer_stories
tools.description: Return active stories posted by one peer.

tools.name: send_story
tools.description: Publish a story (photo or video) on the chosen peer. Visibility defaults to "everyone".

path.description: Local path or URL to the image/video

tools.name: delete_story
tools.description: Remove stories you previously posted.

tools.name: view_story
tools.description: Increment view counters for the given stories.

tools.name: get_story_viewers
tools.description: Show who has viewed a story you posted.

tools.name: ban_user
tools.description: Fully ban a user. Pass `untilDate` (unix seconds) to time-limit the ban; default is forever.

tools.name: unban_user
tools.description: Remove all restrictions for a user.

tools.name: restrict_user
tools.description: Set specific restrictions. `true` for a field means the user CANNOT do that action.

tools.name: promote_admin
tools.description: Grant admin rights. Pass only the fields you want enabled; omitted fields default to false.

tools.name: demote_admin
tools.description: Remove all admin rights from a user.

tools.name: invite_user
tools.description: Add a user (or list of users) to a channel or supergroup.

tools.name: get_participant
tools.description: Return role, rights, and join date for one user in a channel/supergroup.

tools.name: list_participants
tools.description: List members of a group, supergroup, or channel. Optional filter (admins/kicked/banned/bots) and substring search.

tools.name: delete_user_history
tools.description: Wipe every message a given user has posted in the channel/supergroup.

tools.name: kick_participant
tools.description: Remove a user from a chat/channel. Requires admin rights.

tools.name: get_admin_log
tools.description: Return recent admin events. Set fields in `events` to `true` to include those categories; leave empty to include everything.

tools.name: edit_title
tools.description: Set a new title. Works for channels, supergroups, and basic groups.

tools.name: edit_about
tools.description: Set the description of a channel/supergroup. Max 255 chars.

tools.name: edit_photo
tools.description: Upload a new avatar photo from a local path or URL.

tools.name: update_username
tools.description: Assign a new public username. Pass an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: check_username
tools.description: Verify whether a desired channel/supergroup username is free.

tools.name: set_slow_mode
tools.description: Limit how often non-admins can post. Allowed values: 0 (off), 10, 30, 60, 300, 900, 3600 seconds.

tools.name: toggle_signatures
tools.description: Broadcast channels only.

tools.name: toggle_pre_history_hidden
tools.description: Supergroups only. When enabled, new members cannot see history before they joined.

tools.name: toggle_join_request
tools.description: When enabled, new members must be approved by an admin.

tools.name: leave_channel
tools.description: Leave the channel. Use `delete_channel` to also remove it (creator only).

tools.name: get_channel_info
tools.description: Return extended info for a channel or supergroup (about, participants count, linked chat, slow mode).

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Return extended profile info (bio, common chats count, etc.) for a user.

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a broadcast channel (`broadcast: true`) or a supergroup (`megagroup: true`).

tools.name: delete_channel
tools.description: Permanently delete the channel. Creator only.

tools.name: migrate_chat
tools.description: One-way migration. Returns the new supergroup id in the resulting updates.

tools.name: transfer_ownership
tools.description: Transfer creator rights to another user. Requires the account 2FA password (Telegram enforces this).

tools.name: create_invite_link
tools.description: Generate a new invite link with optional expiry, usage cap, and join-request gate.

expireDate.description: Unix seconds — link expires at this time

tools.name: list_invite_links
tools.description: List all invite links the current user can see in a chat.

revoked.description: List revoked links instead of active ones

tools.name: revoke_invite_link
tools.description: Permanently revoke a previously generated invite link.

tools.name: list_invite_joiners
tools.description: List users that joined a chat through a specific invite link.

link.description: Specific invite link; omit to list all joiners

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List topics in a supergroup with forum mode enabled.

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Create a new topic in a forum-enabled supergroup.

tools.name: edit_topic
tools.description: Rename / re-icon / close / hide a topic.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save a draft for a dialog. Pass empty `text` to clear it.

tools.name: clear_draft
tools.description: Equivalent to `save_draft` with an empty text.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: Return all dialog drafts the user has across chats.

tools.name: mute_peer
tools.description: Mute a chat. Without `untilDate`, mutes forever.

tools.name: unmute_peer
tools.description: Clear a mute on a chat.

tools.name: get_notify_settings
tools.description: Return notification settings for a peer.

tools.name: set_notify_settings
tools.description: Update notify settings for a peer (sound, show preview, mute, story mute).

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new dialog folder (chat filter). `id` is auto-assigned to the next free slot 2..255.

tools.name: edit_folder
tools.description: Replace the rules of an existing folder. `id` is required.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Remove a folder by id.

tools.name: reorder_folders
tools.description: Set the display order of folders by passing the list of ids in the desired sequence.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List all users in the contact book.

tools.name: add_contact
tools.description: Add a user to your contacts.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Remove one or more users from the contact book.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search users/chats/channels by a query (matches name, username, and indexed text).

tools.name: block_user
tools.description: Block a user from contacting you.

tools.name: unblock_user
tools.description: Lift a previous block.

tools.name: list_blocked
tools.description: List users currently on the block list.

tools.name: get_privacy
tools.description: Return current rules for one privacy key.

tools.name: set_privacy
tools.description: Replace the privacy rules for a key. `mode` chooses the base policy; `allowUsers`/`disallowUsers` add user-id exceptions.

tools.name: get_my_stickers
tools.description: Return the user's installed sticker sets.

tools.name: install_sticker_set
tools.description: Install a sticker set by its short name (e.g. "AnimatedEmojies").

tools.name: add_recent_sticker
tools.description: Pin a sticker to the recently used list. Use `unsave: true` to remove it.

tools.name: get_my_boosts
tools.description: Return the current boost slots the user has available across channels.

tools.name: apply_boost
tools.description: Apply one or more boost slots to a channel.

tools.name: get_inline_bot_results
tools.description: Run an inline bot query (the `@bot query` form) and return the results.

peer.description: Where the results would be sent — affects allowed result types

tools.name: invoke_mtproto
tools.description: Call any Telegram API method by its qualified name (e.g. `messages.SendMessage`, `channels.GetFullChannel`, `stories.GetAllStories`). String values for fields named peer/channel/user/fromPeer/toPeer/bot/chat are auto-resolved to InputPeer/InputUser. Use this only when no dedicated tool fits — the API surface is huge and there are no per-method safety checks.

params.description: Parameters object for the method constructor
